title: Battling dengue in a warming world: How climate and urbanization shape transmission in low- and middle-income countries (a rapid review).
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is a globally prevalent vector-borne disease, with low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) experiencing a disproportionate burden. Transmission patterns are increasingly influenced by rising global temperatures and rapid urbanization, yet no recent review has synthesized how these environmental factors are reshaping dengue dynamics in LMICs. METHODS: We conducted a rapid systematic review following a registered protocol (PROSPERO: CRD42025635982). Six databases (MEDLINE, Embase, Global Health, SciELO, Global Index Medicus and Web of Science) were searched for peer-reviewed studies published between January 2020 and November 2024. Studies were screened for climate or urbanization factors affecting dengue transmission in LMICs. Study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool for empirical studies and a structured assessment for modeling studies. Findings were synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Of the 65 included studies, 65% reported a positive association between rising temperatures and increased dengue transmission, often attributed to intensified mosquito activity and longer transmission seasons. Urbanization was assessed in 35% of studies, with unplanned growth, informal settlements, and inadequate infrastructure frequently associated with increased risk. Several studies reported geographic expansion into highland and peri-urban areas, as well as seasonal shifts, including earlier onset and prolonged transmission periods. Urban heat islands and land-use change were commonly associated with localized transmission hotspots. Government responses were documented in 29% of studies, though many were hindered by fragmented surveillance systems, limited cross-sector coordination, or insufficient integration of climate data into public health planning. CONCLUSION: Climate change and urbanization are reshaping the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue in LMICs. Adaptive responses require strengthened surveillance and climate-informed planning in resilient urban infrastructure to reduce future transmission risks.

title_zh: 在变暖的世界中抗击登革热:气候和城市化如何影响低收入和中等收入国家的传播(快速回顾)。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Dengue fever is a globally prevalent vector-borne disease, with low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) experiencing a disproportionate burden. Transmission patterns are increasingly influenced by rising global temperatures and rapid urbanization, yet no recent review has synthesized how these environmental factors are reshaping dengue dynamics in LMICs. METHODS: We conducted a rapid systematic review following a registered protocol (PROSPERO: CRD42025635982). Six databases (MEDLINE, Embase, Global Health, SciELO, Global Index Medicus and Web of Science) were searched for peer-reviewed studies published between January 2020 and November 2024. Studies were screened for climate or urbanization factors affecting dengue transmission in LMICs. Study quality was assessed using the Mixed Methods Appraisal Tool for empirical studies and a structured assessment for modeling studies. Findings were synthesized narratively. RESULTS: Of the 65 included studies, 65% reported a positive association between rising temperatures and increased dengue transmission, often attributed to intensified mosquito activity and longer transmission seasons. Urbanization was assessed in 35% of studies, with unplanned growth, informal settlements, and inadequate infrastructure frequently associated with increased risk. Several studies reported geographic expansion into highland and peri-urban areas, as well as seasonal shifts, including earlier onset and prolonged transmission periods. Urban heat islands and land-use change were commonly associated with localized transmission hotspots. Government responses were documented in 29% of studies, though many were hindered by fragmented surveillance systems, limited cross-sector coordination, or insufficient integration of climate data into public health planning. CONCLUSION: Climate change and urbanization are reshaping the spatial and temporal dynamics of dengue in LMICs. Adaptive responses require strengthened surveillance and climate-informed planning in resilient urban infrastructure to reduce future transmission risks.
abstract_zh: 背景:登革热是一种全球流行的媒介传播疾病,低收入和中等收入国家(LMIC)承受着不成比例的负担。传播模式越来越受到全球气温上升和快速城市化的影响,但最近没有综述综合这些环境因素如何重塑中低收入国家的登革热动态。方法:我们按照注册方案(PROSPERO:CRD42025635982)进行了快速系统评价。检索了六个数据库(MEDLINE、Embase、Global Health、SciELO、Global Index Medicus 和 Web of Science),查找 2020 年 1 月至 2024 年 11 月期间发表的同行评审研究。研究筛选了影响中低收入国家登革热传播的气候或城市化因素。研究质量使用混合方法评估工具进行实证研究和结构化评估进行建模研究。调查结果以叙述方式综合。结果:在纳入的 65 项研究中,65% 报告称气温升高与登革热传播增加之间存在正相关关系,这通常归因于蚊子活动加剧和传播季节延长。35% 的研究对城市化进行了评估,无计划的增长、非正规住区和基础设施不足往往与风险增加相关。几项研究报告了向高地和城郊地区的地理扩张以及季节性变化,包括发病提前和传播周期延长。城市热岛和土地利用变化通常与局部传输热点有关。29% 的研究记录了政府的应对措施,尽管许多研究因监测系统分散、跨部门协调有限或气候数据未充分纳入公共卫生规划而受到阻碍。结论:气候变化和城市化正在重塑中低收入国家登革热的时空动态。适应性应对措施需要在有弹性的城市基础设施中加强监测和气候知情的规划,以减少未来的传播风险。

title: Dengue Fever Complicated by Acute Acalculous Cholecystitis and Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis Despite Negative PCR.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To report a case of dengue fever complicated by acute acalculous cholecystitis (AAC) and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), despite initial negative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) results. METHODS: We describe the clinical course of a 40-year-old woman who returned from Indonesia with a persistent fever and rash. The diagnosis was established through clinical evaluation, serological testing, and abdominal imaging. The study conformed to the principles outlined in the Declaration of Helsinki. RESULTS: Although the initial dengue PCR result was negative, subsequent NS1 and IgM antibody test results were positive. The patient developed severe complications, including AAC, characterized by gallbladder wall thickening, and HLH, indicated by marked fever, splenomegaly, hypofibrinogenemia, hyperferritinemia, and high soluble IL-2 receptor levels. Despite these symptoms, the patient was managed conservatively. Planned percutaneous transhepatic gallbladder aspiration was canceled because of spontaneous improvement observed on ultrasonography. The patient recovered fully without corticosteroid or platelet transfusions and was discharged on day 14. CONCLUSION: Given the potential for false-negative PCR results during the acute phase of dengue, multimodal serological testing is essential. This case demonstrates that severe atypical complications, such as AAC and HLH, can be resolved with supportive care alone, avoiding invasive procedures, immunosuppressive therapy, and platelet transfusion.

title_zh: 尽管 PCR 呈阴性,但登革热仍并发急性非结石性胆囊炎和噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症。
source_body_en: OBJECTIVE: To report a case of dengue fever complicated by acute acalculous cholecystitis (AAC) and hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (HLH), despite initial negative polymerase chain reaction (PCR) results. METHODS: We describe the clinical course of a 40-year-old woman who returned from Indonesia with a persistent fever and rash. The diagnosis was established through clinical evaluation, serological testing, and abdominal imaging. The study conformed to the principles outlined in the Declaration of Helsinki. RESULTS: Although the initial dengue PCR result was negative, subsequent NS1 and IgM antibody test results were positive. The patient developed severe complications, including AAC, characterized by gallbladder wall thickening, and HLH, indicated by marked fever, splenomegaly, hypofibrinogenemia, hyperferritinemia, and high soluble IL-2 receptor levels. Despite these symptoms, the patient was managed conservatively. Planned percutaneous transhepatic gallbladder aspiration was canceled because of spontaneous improvement observed on ultrasonography. The patient recovered fully without corticosteroid or platelet transfusions and was discharged on day 14. CONCLUSION: Given the potential for false-negative PCR results during the acute phase of dengue, multimodal serological testing is essential. This case demonstrates that severe atypical complications, such as AAC and HLH, can be resolved with supportive care alone, avoiding invasive procedures, immunosuppressive therapy, and platelet transfusion.
abstract_zh: 目的:报告一例登革热并发急性非结石性胆囊炎(AAC)和噬血细胞性淋巴组织细胞增多症(HLH)的病例,尽管最初的聚合酶链反应(PCR)结果呈阴性。方法:我们描述了一名 40 岁女性的临床病程,她从印度尼西亚返回,出现持续发烧和皮疹。通过临床评估、血清学检测和腹部影像学检查确定诊断。该研究符合《赫尔辛基宣言》中概述的原则。结果:虽然最初的登革热PCR结果呈阴性,但随后的NS1和IgM抗体检测结果呈阳性。患者出现了严重的并发症,包括以胆囊壁增厚为特征的 AAC 和以明显发热、脾肿大、低纤维蛋白原血症、高铁蛋白血症和高可溶性 IL-2 受体水平为特征的 HLH。尽管有这些症状,患者仍接受保守治疗。由于超声检查观察到自发性改善,计划的经皮肝穿刺胆囊抽吸术被取消。患者在未输注皮质类固醇或血小板的情况下完全康复,并于第 14 天出院。结论:鉴于登革热急性期 PCR 结果可能出现假阴性,多模式血清学检测至关重要。该病例表明,严重的非典型并发症,如 AAC 和 HLH,可以仅通过支持性护理来解决,避免侵入性手术、免疫抑制治疗和血小板输注。

title: Dengue virus-A neglected entity but causing global threat
abstract: Aim: Dengue is a viral disease that is transmitted by the Aedes mosquito. It is found in tropical and subtropical regions of the world and is a major publichealth concern due to its high morbidity and mortality rates.Materials and Methods: The symptoms of dengue can range from mild to severe, and in some cases, it can be fatal. There is no specific treatment fordengue, but supportive care can help to alleviate symptoms and reduce the risk of complications. The virus that causes dengue is part of the Flavivirus genus,and there are four distinct serotypes. Once a person is infected with one serotype, they develop immunity to that particular serotype but remain susceptibleto the other three. Infection with a different serotype can increase the risk of severe dengue, which is also known as dengue hemorrhagic fever.Results: Various prevention measures for dengue include reducing the mosquito population through insecticide spraying, eliminating standing water wheremosquitoes breed, and using mosquito repellent. There is also a vaccine available for dengue, although it is not recommended for everyone and has limitedefficacy against all serotypes.Conclusion: Overall, dengue remains a significant public health issue, particularly in areas where the mosquito population is high and the healthcare systemis not well-equipped to handle severe cases. Ongoing efforts are needed to improve prevention.

title: [Clinical characteristics and outcomes of neonatal dengue fever in Foshan].
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To study the clinical characteristics, treatment, and outcomes of neonatal dengue fever in Foshan. METHODS: A retrospective study was conducted on 49 neonatal dengue fever cases collected from eight hospitals in Foshan between June and November 2024. Clinical characteristics and outcomes were evaluated. Cases were divided into an early-onset group (diagnosed ≤7 days of age; n=32) and a late-onset group (diagnosed 7 days of age; n=17) for comparison of clinical characteristics. RESULTS: Among the 49 neonates, fever was the predominant symptom (45 cases, 92%), followed by bleeding tendency (12 cases, 24%), tachypnea (11 cases, 22%), and jaundice (5 cases, 10%). The mothers of 30 neonates (61%) had perinatal dengue infection. Rates of maternal peripartum fever, confirmed maternal dengue fever during pregnancy, and perinatal dengue infection were significantly higher in the early-onset group than in the late-onset group (P0.05). The early-onset group had a longer hospital stay than the late-onset group (P0.05). Alanine aminotransferase levels were significantly higher in the late-onset group than in the early-onset group (P0.05). Symptomatic treatments, including short-term hemostatic therapy, nasal cannula oxygen supplementation, and noninvasive positive pressure ventilation when indicated, resulted in favorable outcomes without severe cases or deaths. CONCLUSIONS: Neonatal dengue fever in Foshan is associated with maternal perinatal dengue infection. Fever is the predominant clinical manifestation. Clinical characteristics differ by age at diagnosis, but overall prognosis is good. During dengue epidemic seasons, prevention and screening of perinatal dengue fever in pregnant women should be strengthened, and early laboratory tests such as pathogen detection and blood biochemistry should be performed on high-risk neonates.

abstract_zh: 目的:了解佛山市新生儿登革热的临床特征、治疗及转归。方法:对2024年6月至11月佛山市8家医院收治的49例新生儿登革热病例进行回顾性研究,评估其临床特征和转归。将病例分为早发组(诊断≤7天龄;n=32)和晚发组(诊断7天龄;n=17),比较临床特征。结果 49例新生儿中,以发热为主要症状(45例,92%),其次为出血倾向(12例,24%)、呼吸急促(11例,22%)、黄疸(5例,10%)。30 名新生儿(61%)的母亲患有围产期登革热感染。早发组孕产妇围产期发热、孕期确诊登革热、围生期登革热感染率均显着高于晚发组(P<0。05)。早发型组住院时间长于晚发型组(P<0。05)。晚发型组谷丙转氨酶水平显着高于早发型组(P<0。05)。对症治疗,包括短期止血治疗、鼻插管供氧和无创正压通气(有指征时),取得了良好的结果,没有出现严重病例或死亡。结论:佛山市新生儿登革热与孕产妇围产期登革热感染相关。发热是主要临床表现。临床特征因诊断年龄而异,但总体预后良好。登革热流行季节,应加强孕妇围产期登革热预防和筛查,对高危新生儿早期进行病原检测、血液生化等实验室检查。

title: A smartphone-assisted paper-based colorimetric biosensor for rapid detection of dengue NS1 antigen.
abstract: Dengue virus infection poses significant health risks, so rapid and early diagnosis is essential to mitigate these risks effectively. In this study, a paper-based NS1 biosensor was developed using surface-modified gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) bioconjugated with the NS1 monoclonal antibody (mAb) for colorimetric detection. The paper-based NS1 biosensor exhibits a color change upon interaction with the dengue NS1 antigen. Color signals were captured using a smartphone, and the images were analyzed in ImageJ to extract red, green, and blue (RGB) intensities for quantitative analysis. The paper-based NS1 biosensor exhibited a linear response for the detection of dengue NS1 antigen over the concentration range of 75 to 250 ng/mL, with a linear regression coefficient (R2) of 0.997, a limit of detection (LOD) of 10.95 ng/mL, and a detection time of 15 minutes. The paper-based NS1 biosensor demonstrated good selectivity, precision (RSD < 5%), and recovery from 93.40% to 98.54% in human serum samples. These findings indicate that the paper-based NS1 biosensor has potential as a simple, low-cost, portable, and potential as point-of-care device for early detection of the dengue virus.

source_records.title: A smartphone-assisted paper-based colorimetric biosensor for rapid detection of dengue NS1 antigen.
source_records.abstract: Dengue virus infection poses significant health risks, so rapid and early diagnosis is essential to mitigate these risks effectively. In this study, a paper-based NS1 biosensor was developed using surface-modified gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) bioconjugated with the NS1 monoclonal antibody (mAb) for colorimetric detection. The paper-based NS1 biosensor exhibits a color change upon interaction with the dengue NS1 antigen. Color signals were captured using a smartphone, and the images were analyzed in ImageJ to extract red, green, and blue (RGB) intensities for quantitative analysis. The paper-based NS1 biosensor exhibited a linear response for the detection of dengue NS1 antigen over the concentration range of 75 to 250 ng/mL, with a linear regression coefficient (R2) of 0.997, a limit of detection (LOD) of 10.95 ng/mL, and a detection time of 15 minutes. The paper-based NS1 biosensor demonstrated good selectivity, precision (RSD < 5%), and recovery from 93.40% to 98.54% in human serum samples. These findings indicate that the paper-based NS1 biosensor has potential as a simple, low-cost, portable, and potential as point-of-care device for early detection of the dengue virus.

title: Post-infectious dengue cerebellitis in a patient with transfusion-dependent β-thalassaemia major: A case report
abstract: Dengue fever is endemic in Sri Lanka and can rarely cause neurological complications, including post-infectious cerebellitis. Although patients with β-thalassaemia major have altered immune profiles, the intersection of expanded dengue syndrome with underlying haematological disorders is poorly documented. We report a 22-year-old woman with optimally managed, transfusion-dependent β-thalassaemia major who developed progressive cerebellar dysfunction eleven days after the onset of dengue haemorrhagic fever. Neurological examination revealed characteristic cerebellar signs, and the magnetic resonance imaging of the brain was normal. A clinical diagnosis of post-infectious dengue cerebellitis was made. Intravenous methylprednisolone led to rapid and complete resolution of symptoms.This case highlights a rare neurological sequela of dengue and underscores the need for vigilance for post-infectious autoimmune complications in multiply transfused patients, even when iron overload is minimal. We propose that chronic alloantigen exposure from lifelong transfusions establishes a constitutively dysregulated adaptive immune state, characterised by expanded Tregs and elevated IL-6, IL-10, and TGF-β, which may amplify post-viral autoimmune responses irrespective of iron overload status. This case emphasises the importance of early recognition and immunosuppressive treatment of immune-mediated neurological complications in optimally managed, multiply transfused patients.
journal: Journal of the Ceylon College of Physicians

We report a 22-year-old woman with optimally managed, transfusion-dependent β-thalassaemia major who developed progressive cerebellar dysfunction eleven days after the onset of dengue haemorrhagic fever. Neurological examination revealed characteristic cerebellar signs, and the magnetic resonance imaging of the brain was normal. A clinical diagnosis of post-infectious dengue cerebellitis was made. Intravenous methylprednisolone led to rapid and complete resolution of symptoms.This case highlights a rare neurological sequela of dengue and underscores the need for vigilance for post-infectious autoimmune complications in multiply transfused patients, even when iron overload is minimal. We propose that chronic alloantigen exposure from lifelong transfusions establishes a constitutively dysregulated adaptive immune state, characterised by expanded Tregs and elevated IL-6, IL-10, and TGF-β, which may amplify post-viral autoimmune responses irrespective of iron overload status. This case emphasises the importance of early recognition and immunosuppressive treatment of immune-mediated neurological complications in optimally managed, multiply transfused patients.

abstract_zh: 登革热在斯里兰卡流行,很少会引起神经系统并发症,包括感染后小脑炎。尽管重型 β 地中海贫血患者的免疫特征发生了改变,但扩展的登革热综合征与潜在的血液系统疾病之间的交叉记录却很少。我们报告了一名 22 岁女性,患有经过最佳治疗的输血依赖性重型 β 地中海贫血,她在登革出血热发病 11 天后出现进行性小脑功能障碍。神经系统检查显示特征性小脑体征,大脑磁共振成像正常。临床诊断为感染后登革热小脑炎。静脉注射甲基强的松龙可快速、完全缓解症状。该病例凸显了登革热的罕见神经系统后遗症,并强调即使在铁超负荷很少的情况下,也需要对多次输血患者的感染后自身免疫并发症保持警惕。我们认为,终生输血导致的慢性同种异体抗原暴露会建立一种组成性失调的适应性免疫状态,其特征是Treg细胞扩增和IL-6、IL-10和TGF-β升高,这可能会放大病毒后自身免疫反应,无论铁超载状态如何。该病例强调了在最佳管理的多次输血患者中早期识别免疫介导的神经系统并发症并进行免疫抑制治疗的重要性。

title: Bridging surveillance gaps in dengue: a hierarchical model integrating mixed data sources for transmission estimation and vaccine targeting
abstract: Estimating dengue force of infection (FOI) is essential for understanding transmission dynamics and targeting intervention programmes, yet surveillance data in endemic settings required for estimations are often incomplete, with varying formats. We developed a Bayesian hierarchical catalytic model that jointly fits age-stratified case data, aggregate case data, and seroprevalence surveys within a single framework, incorporating external covariates to improve parameter identifiability. Synthetic validation showed that covariates alone recovered accurate FOI point estimates even when most districts contributed only aggregate data, but did so with poorly calibrated uncertainty; anchoring the model with a single seroprevalence survey was necessary to bring credible interval coverage close to nominal. Applied to 128 districts across Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016-2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in FOI and reporting rates. Many districts in Java exceeded the WHO-suggested seroprevalence threshold for vaccine introduction, yet were classified as low-priority when using reported incidence as prioritisation criterion, particularly in areas with weak surveillance. Model-based seroprevalence estimation, integrating multiple data sources, offers a more consistent basis for identifying high-priority districts for vaccine introduction, and is less susceptible to surveillance bias than reported incidence.

Synthetic validation showed that covariates alone recovered accurate FOI point estimates even when most districts contributed only aggregate data, but did so with poorly calibrated uncertainty; anchoring the model with a single seroprevalence survey was necessary to bring credible interval coverage close to nominal. Applied to 128 districts across Java and Bali, Indonesia (2016-2024), the model revealed substantial spatial heterogeneity in FOI and reporting rates. Many districts in Java exceeded the WHO-suggested seroprevalence threshold for vaccine introduction, yet were classified as low-priority when using reported incidence as prioritisation criterion, particularly in areas with weak surveillance. Model-based seroprevalence estimation, integrating multiple data sources, offers a more consistent basis for identifying high-priority districts for vaccine introduction, and is less susceptible to surveillance bias than reported incidence.

abstract_zh: 估计登革热感染力 (FOI) 对于了解传播动态和制定干预计划至关重要,但估计所需的流行环境中的监测数据往往不完整,且格式各异。我们开发了一个贝叶斯分层催化模型,该模型在单一框架内联合拟合年龄分层病例数据、汇总病例数据和血清阳性率调查,并结合外部协变量以提高参数可识别性。综合验证表明,即使大多数地区仅提供汇总数据,仅协变量也能恢复准确的 FOI 点估计,但这样做的不确定性校准不佳;有必要将模型与单一血清流行率调查结合起来,以使可信区间覆盖范围接近名义值。该模型应用于印度尼西亚爪哇岛和巴厘岛的 128 个地区(2016-2024 年),揭示了 FOI 和报告率的显着空间异质性。爪哇的许多地区超过了世界卫生组织建议的疫苗接种血清阳性率阈值,但在使用报告的发病率作为优先标准时被列为低优先级,特别是在监测薄弱的地区。基于模型的血清流行率估计整合了多个数据源,为确定疫苗引进的高优先级地区提供了更一致的基础,并且比报告的发病率更不易受到监测偏差的影响。

title: Rural–Urban Variation in Dengue Vector Breeding Dynamics in Madurai District, Tamil Nadu, India: A Geo-Medical Study
abstract: Dengue is one of the most important mosquito-borne viral diseases affecting tropical and subtropical regions worldwide. The principal dengue vectors, Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, exhibit considerable spatial and seasonal variation in their breeding ecology, particularly between rural and urban environments. This study investigated rural–urban variation in dengue vector breeding dynamics in Madurai District, Tamil Nadu, India, using a geo-medical approach. Primary field surveys were conducted in 705 randomly selected households across seven taluks during the dry and wet seasons. Larval and pupal samples were collected from different breeding containers, reared to adulthood, and identified at the ICMR–Vector Control Research Centre, Madurai. Adult mosquito abundance was assessed using the Adult Premise Index (API) and Female per Positive House (FPPH). Principal component analysis (PCA), hierarchical cluster analysis, and heat-map analysis were used to examine seasonal breeding patterns and spatial variation in vector distribution. The results indicated that Ae. aegypti predominated in urban areas, particularly during the dry season, when artificial containers such as tyres, barrels, cisterns, grinding stones, and earthen pots served as major breeding habitats. albopictus was more abundant during the wet season and was more frequently associated with rural and peri-urban environments. Several taluks recorded higher API and FPPH values, indicating spatial variation in adult mosquito density and potential dengue transmission risk. The findings showed that dengue vector ecology differed between rural and urban settings and varied across seasons. These results highlight the importance of location-specific surveillance, source reduction, and integrated vector management strategies for improving dengue prevention and control in Madurai District.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 登革热是热带地区主要的蚊媒病毒性疾病,主要媒介埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊在繁殖生态方面表现出空间和季节变化,特别是在农村和城市环境之间(A1、A2)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项地理医学研究调查了印度泰米尔纳德邦马杜赖地区登革热病媒繁殖动态的城乡差异,在旱季和雨季对七个塔鲁克岛的 705 个随机选择的家庭进行了初步实地调查(A3、A4)。
elements_zh.methods: 从繁殖容器中收集幼虫和蛹样本,饲养至成年,并在马杜赖 ICMR 病媒控制研究中心进行鉴定,同时使用成虫前提指数 (API) 和每阳性鸡舍雌性 (FPPH) 评估成蚊丰度 (A5、A6)。
elements_zh.main_results: 主成分分析 (PCA)、层次聚类分析和热图分析用于检查季节性繁殖模式和媒介分布的空间变化 (A7),结果表明登革热媒介生态在农村和城市环境之间存在差异,并且随季节变化 (A12)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 旱季期间,使用人工容器的城市地区埃及伊蚊占主导地位,而白纹伊蚊在雨季期间在农村和城市周边环境中更为丰富(A9、A10),这表明媒介生态学中存在新的空间和季节差异(A12)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果凸显了针对特定地点的监测、减少源头和综合病媒管理策略对于改善马杜赖区登革热预防和控制的重要性 (A13)。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告具体限制、偏倚、混杂因素、样本量合理性或对照,并且证据强度评估为中等(A3、A4、A7)。

title_zh: 印度泰米尔纳德邦马杜赖地区登革热媒介繁殖动态的城乡差异:地理医学研究
source_body_en: Dengue is one of the most important mosquito-borne viral diseases affecting tropical and subtropical regions worldwide. The principal dengue vectors, Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, exhibit considerable spatial and seasonal variation in their breeding ecology, particularly between rural and urban environments. This study investigated rural–urban variation in dengue vector breeding dynamics in Madurai District, Tamil Nadu, India, using a geo-medical approach. Primary field surveys were conducted in 705 randomly selected households across seven taluks during the dry and wet seasons. Larval and pupal samples were collected from different breeding containers, reared to adulthood, and identified at the ICMR–Vector Control Research Centre, Madurai. Adult mosquito abundance was assessed using the Adult Premise Index (API) and Female per Positive House (FPPH). Principal component analysis (PCA), hierarchical cluster analysis, and heat-map analysis were used to examine seasonal breeding patterns and spatial variation in vector distribution. The results indicated that Ae. aegypti predominated in urban areas, particularly during the dry season, when artificial containers such as tyres, barrels, cisterns, grinding stones, and earthen pots served as major breeding habitats. albopictus was more abundant during the wet season and was more frequently associated with rural and peri-urban environments. Several taluks recorded higher API and FPPH values, indicating spatial variation in adult mosquito density and potential dengue transmission risk. The findings showed that dengue vector ecology differed between rural and urban settings and varied across seasons. These results highlight the importance of location-specific surveillance, source reduction, and integrated vector management strategies for improving dengue prevention and control in Madurai District.
abstract_zh: 登革热是影响全球热带和亚热带地区的最重要的蚊媒病毒性疾病之一。登革热的主要媒介埃及伊蚊和白纹伊蚊的繁殖生态表现出相当大的空间和季节变化,特别是在农村和城市环境之间。本研究采用地理医学方法调查了印度泰米尔纳德邦马杜赖地区登革热病媒繁殖动态的城乡差异。在旱季和雨季,对 7 个塔鲁克的 705 个随机选择的家庭进行了初步实地调查。幼虫和蛹样本是从不同的繁殖容器中收集的,饲养至成年,并在马杜赖 ICMR 病媒控制研究中心进行鉴定。使用成虫指数(API)和每阳性鸡舍雌性(FPPH)评估成蚊丰度。主成分分析(PCA)、层次聚类分析和热图分析用于检查季节性繁殖模式和矢量分布的空间变化。结果表明,Ae.埃及伊蚊在城市地区占主导地位,特别是在旱季,轮胎、桶、蓄水池、磨石和陶罐等人造容器成为主要的繁殖栖息地。白纹伊蚊在雨季更为丰富,并且更常与农村和城郊环境相关。一些塔鲁克记录了较高的 API 和 FPPH 值,表明成年蚊子密度的空间变化和潜在的登革热传播风险。研究结果表明,登革热媒介生态在农村和城市环境之间存在差异,并且随季节变化。这些结果凸显了针对特定地点的监测、减少源头和综合病媒管理策略对于改善马杜赖地区登革热预防和控制的重要性。

title: EDUCAÇÃO EM SAÚDE COMO ESTRATÉGIA DE PREVENÇÃO E CONTROLE DA DENGUE NA COMUNIDADE
abstract: A dengue constitui uma importante arbovirose de relevância epidemiológica, especialmente em países tropicais como o Brasil, onde fatores ambientais, socioeconômicos e falhas no saneamento favorecem a proliferação do mosquito Aedes aegypti. Diante do aumento expressivo de casos registrados em 2024, destaca-se a importância da Atenção Primária à Saúde na promoção de ações preventivas e educativas voltadas ao controle da doença. Este estudo trata-se de um relato de experiência desenvolvido a partir de uma ação de educação em saúde realizada no Centro de Saúde da Família Gerardo Carneiro Hardy, fundamentada na metodologia do Círculo de Cultura de Paulo Freire e nos princípios da Educação Popular. Participaram da atividade 26 moradores da comunidade, que foram envolvidos em uma roda de conversa sobre prevenção da dengue, identificação de sinais e sintomas, eliminação de criadouros e estratégias de combate ao vetor. Observou-se participação ativa dos usuários, compartilhamento de experiências e fortalecimento do vínculo entre comunidade e serviço de saúde. Conclui-se que metodologias participativas favorecem a construção coletiva do conhecimento, estimulam práticas preventivas e fortalecem a corresponsabilização social no enfrentamento da dengue, reforçando a necessidade de maior envolvimento multiprofissional nas ações educativas em saúde.

title_zh: 预防和控制登革热社区教育策略
source_body_en: A dengue constitui uma importante arbovirose de relevância epidemiológica, especialmente em países tropicais como o Brasil, onde fatores ambientais, socioeconômicos e falhas no saneamento favorecem a proliferação do mosquito Aedes aegypti. Diante do aumento expressivo de casos registrados em 2024, destaca-se a importância da Atenção Primária à Saúde na promoção de ações preventivas e educativas voltadas ao controle da doença. Este estudo trata-se de um relato de experiência desenvolvido a partir de uma ação de educação em saúde realizada no Centro de Saúde da Família Gerardo Carneiro Hardy, fundamentada na metodologia do Círculo de Cultura de Paulo Freire e nos princípios da Educação Popular. Participaram da atividade 26 moradores da comunidade, que foram envolvidos em uma roda de conversa sobre prevenção da dengue, identificação de sinais e sintomas, eliminação de criadouros e estratégias de combate ao vetor. Observou-se participação ativa dos usuários, compartilhamento de experiências e fortalecimento do vínculo entre comunidade e serviço de saúde. Conclui-se que metodologias participativas favorecem a construção coletiva do conhecimento, estimulam práticas preventivas e fortalecem a corresponsabilização social no enfrentamento da dengue, reforçando a necessidade de maior envolvimento multiprofissional nas ações educativas em saúde.

title: Hubungan Jumlah Trombosit Dengan Nilai Hematokrit Pada Infeksi Sekunder Dengue Di RSUD Pasar Rebo
abstract: Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat serius di Indonesia dengan prevalensi tinggi, khususnya pada kasus infeksi sekunder yang beresiko menimbulkan manifestasi lebih berat. Perubahan jumlah trombosit dan nilai hematokrit sering digunakan sebagai indikator laboratorium, namun hasil penelitian sebelumnya menunjukkan variasi temuan terkait hubungan keduanya. Tujuan penelitian ini untuk mengetahui hubungan antara jumlah trombosit dengan nilai hematokrit pada pasien infeksi sekunder dengue di RSUD Pasar Rebo. Penelitian ini menggunakan data sekunder dengan menggunakan metode kuantitatif deskriptif dan pendekatan cross sectional. Data diperoleh dari rekam medis pasien rawat inap dengan diagnosis infeksi sekunder dengue yang dikonfirmasi melalui pemeriksaan serologi IgG dan IgM positif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui teknik purposive sampling dan dianalisis menggunakan uji univariat serta bivariat dengan korelasi Spearman. Pada penelitian ini ditemukan bahwa 79,3% pasien dengan infeksi dengue sekunder mengalami trombositopenia tanpa disertai hemokonsentrasi. Kesimpulan yang didapat adalah tidak terdapat hubungan jumlah trombosit dengan nilai hematokrit pada infeksi sekunder dengue.

title_zh: 帕萨尔雷博医院登革热继发感染患者血小板计数与血细胞比容值关系研究
source_body_en: Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) masih menjadi masalah kesehatan masyarakat serius di Indonesia dengan prevalensi tinggi, khususnya pada kasus infeksi sekunder yang beresiko menimbulkan manifestasi lebih berat. Perubahan jumlah trombosit dan nilai hematokrit sering digunakan sebagai indikator laboratorium, namun hasil penelitian sebelumnya menunjukkan variasi temuan terkait hubungan keduanya. Tujuan penelitian ini untuk mengetahui hubungan antara jumlah trombosit dengan nilai hematokrit pada pasien infeksi sekunder dengue di RSUD Pasar Rebo. Penelitian ini menggunakan data sekunder dengan menggunakan metode kuantitatif deskriptif dan pendekatan cross sectional. Data diperoleh dari rekam medis pasien rawat inap dengan diagnosis infeksi sekunder dengue yang dikonfirmasi melalui pemeriksaan serologi IgG dan IgM positif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui teknik purposive sampling dan dianalisis menggunakan uji univariat serta bivariat dengan korelasi Spearman. Pada penelitian ini ditemukan bahwa 79,3% pasien dengan infeksi dengue sekunder mengalami trombositopenia tanpa disertai hemokonsentrasi. Kesimpulan yang didapat adalah tidak terdapat hubungan jumlah trombosit dengan nilai hematokrit pada infeksi sekunder dengue.

title: Negative Binomial tv-DINGARCH Models for Monthly DHF Cases in Surabaya, Indonesia (2015-2025)
abstract: Count time series data are commonly encountered in epidemiological studies, such as monthly reports of Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) cases. The INGARCH model has been widely used to handle temporal dependence and overdispersion in such data. However, the standard INGARCH model assumes constant dispersion, whereas in practice the dispersion level may vary over time due to epidemiological factors like seasonality or vector control policies. Accurately capturing this time-varying variability is essential for reliable disease surveillance. This study applies the tv-DINGARCH model to DHF cases in Surabaya from January 2015 to December 2025. The tv-DINGARCH(1,1,1,1) model with Negative Binomial distribution is used because it allows the dispersion parameter \(\phi_t\) to evolve dynamically. Parameter estimation is conducted using the Conditional Maximum Likelihood Estimation method implemented in RStudio. The results show that the tv-DINGARCH model yields AIC = 968.43 and BIC = 985.68, both smaller than those of the standard INGARCH model (AIC = 1012.18, BIC = 1023.68). The likelihood ratio test produces an LR statistic of 47.7560 with a p-value less than 0.000001, strongly rejecting constant dispersion. The stationarity condition is satisfied with \(\beta_2 + \alpha_2 + \beta_1 + \alpha_1 = 0.9990 1\). From a public health perspective, these findings indicate that the tv-DINGARCH model better captures the fluctuating dynamics of DHF transmission, supporting more effective surveillance and early warning systems.
journal: CAUCHY Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

abstract_zh: 流行病学研究中经常会遇到计数时间序列数据,例如登革出血热 (DHF) 病例的月度报告。INGARCH 模型已广泛用于处理此类数据中的时间依赖性和过度分散。然而,标准 INGARCH 模型假设离散程度恒定,而实际上,由于季节性或病媒控制政策等流行病学因素,离散程度可能随时间变化。准确捕捉这种随时间变化的变异性对于可靠的疾病监测至关重要。本研究将 tv-DINGARCH 模型应用于泗水 2015 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月的 DHF 病例。使用负二项分布的 tv-DINGARCH(1,1,1,1) 模型是因为它允许离散参数 \(\phi_t\) 动态演化。参数估计是使用 RStudio 中实现的条件最大似然估计方法进行的。结果表明,tv-DINGARCH 模型的 AIC = 968.43 和 BIC = 985.68,均小于标准 INGARCH 模型的结果(AIC = 1012.18,BIC = 1023.68)。似然比检验产生 LR 统计量为 47.7560,p 值小于 0.000001,强烈拒绝恒定离散。平稳性条件满足 \(\beta_2 + \alpha_2 + \beta_1 + \alpha_1 = 0.9990 1\)。从公共卫生角度来看,这些发现表明 tv-DINGARCH 模型更好地捕捉 DHF 传播的波动动态,支持更有效的监测和预警系统。

title: Structure-based Free Energy Evaluation of Papaya Flavonoids as Dengue Virus NS5 RdRp Inhibitors via Molecular Simulations, Steered Molecular Dynamics, and Umbrella Sampling
abstract: Dengue virus (DENV) NS5’s RdRp domain is a conserved and functionally necessary enzyme, making it an interesting antiviral target. This study examined Carica papaya flavonoids’ efficacy in inhibiting DENV-RdRp’s allosteric binding domain utilizing structure-based in silico methods. Eight flavonoids were evaluated for RdRp enzyme binding affinity using molecular dynamics simulations, principal component analysis, and free energy landscapes. The molecular simulation studies predicted the formation of stable protein–ligand complex structures in a biological system. Further protein–ligand structure dissociation and unbinding energetics were quantified using SMD simulations with umbrella sampling. By deriving free energy profiles, all eight RdRp-flavonoid complexes showed thermodynamic feasibility for protein–ligand binding with neohesperidin, manghaslin, and isoquercetin complexes having binding energies of −17.35 kcal⋅mol[Formula: see text], −16.52 kcal⋅mol[Formula: see text], and −16.04 kcal⋅mol[Formula: see text], respectively. These results were aligned with the MD and post-MD MMGBSA binding free energy calculations. Thus, we successfully identified and analyzed papaya flavonoid-based natural scaffolds that target DENV-RdRp using advanced molecular simulation methods.
journal: Journal of Computational Biophysics and Chemistry

Eight flavonoids were evaluated for RdRp enzyme binding affinity using molecular dynamics simulations, principal component analysis, and free energy landscapes. The molecular simulation studies predicted the formation of stable protein–ligand complex structures in a biological system. Further protein–ligand structure dissociation and unbinding energetics were quantified using SMD simulations with umbrella sampling. By deriving free energy profiles, all eight RdRp-flavonoid complexes showed thermodynamic feasibility for protein–ligand binding with neohesperidin, manghaslin, and isoquercetin complexes having binding energies of −17.35 kcal⋅mol[Formula: see text], −16.52 kcal⋅mol[Formula: see text], and −16.04 kcal⋅mol[Formula: see text], respectively. These results were aligned with the MD and post-MD MMGBSA binding free energy calculations. Thus, we successfully identified and analyzed papaya flavonoid-based natural scaffolds that target DENV-RdRp using advanced molecular simulation methods.

abstract_zh: 登革热病毒 (DENV) NS5 的 RdRp 结构域是一种保守且功能必需的酶,使其成为有趣的抗病毒靶点。本研究利用基于结构的计算机方法检验了番木瓜类黄酮抑制 DENV-RdRp 变构结合域的功效。使用分子动力学模拟、主成分分析和自由能图谱评估了八种黄酮类化合物的 RdRp 酶结合亲和力。分子模拟研究预测了生物系统中稳定的蛋白质-配体复合结构的形成。使用伞式采样的 SMD 模拟对进一步的蛋白质-配体结构解离和解离能量进行了量化。通过推导自由能曲线,所有八种 RdRp-类黄酮复合物均显示出与新橙皮苷、芒哈斯林和异槲皮素复合物进行蛋白质-配体结合的热力学可行性,其结合能分别为−17.35 kcal·mol[式:见文本]、-16.52 kcal·mol[式:见文本]和-16.04 kcal·mol[式:见文本]。这些结果与 MD 和 MD 后 MMGBSA 结合自由能计算一致。因此,我们使用先进的分子模拟方法成功鉴定和分析了以 DENV-RdRp 为目标的基于木瓜类黄酮的天然支架。

title: Mechanism and spectrum of inhibition of viral polymerases by 2′-deoxy-2′-β-fluoro-4′-azidocytidine or azvudine
abstract: The therapeutic value of antiviral nucleoside analogs was highlighted during the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, with remdesivir and molnupiravir repurposed for their broad-spectrum antiviral activity. The cytidine analog azvudine (FNC) has recently gained attention as a potential treatment for human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection. Considering the distinct substrate specificities of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase (RT) and SARS-CoV-2 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), a unifying mechanism of inhibition remains elusive. Here, we assessed the inhibitory effects of FNC’s active triphosphate form, FNC-TP, across several viral polymerases. The relative efficiency of FNC-TP incorporation followed the order: HIV-1 RT > hepatitis C virus (HCV) RdRp > respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) RdRp > dengue virus type 2 (DENV-2) RdRp ≫ SARS-CoV-2 RdRp. Its incorporation caused chain-termination in all polymerases tested. Antiviral activity against HIV-1 has previously been demonstrated and is here shown with DENV-2. Collectively, the data show that inhibition of viral polymerases by FNC-TP can translate to antiviral activity against both retroviruses and RNA viruses, but the link is not evident for SARS-CoV-2. FNC-TP is a poor substrate for SARS-CoV-2 RdRp, and FNC lacks significant antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2 in cell culture.

title_zh: 2′-脱氧-2′-β-氟-4′-叠氮胞苷或阿兹夫定抑制病毒聚合酶的机制和谱
source_body_en: The therapeutic value of antiviral nucleoside analogs was highlighted during the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic, with remdesivir and molnupiravir repurposed for their broad-spectrum antiviral activity. The cytidine analog azvudine (FNC) has recently gained attention as a potential treatment for human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) and severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) infection. Considering the distinct substrate specificities of HIV-1 reverse transcriptase (RT) and SARS-CoV-2 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), a unifying mechanism of inhibition remains elusive. Here, we assessed the inhibitory effects of FNC’s active triphosphate form, FNC-TP, across several viral polymerases. The relative efficiency of FNC-TP incorporation followed the order: HIV-1 RT > hepatitis C virus (HCV) RdRp > respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) RdRp > dengue virus type 2 (DENV-2) RdRp ≫ SARS-CoV-2 RdRp. Its incorporation caused chain-termination in all polymerases tested. Antiviral activity against HIV-1 has previously been demonstrated and is here shown with DENV-2. Collectively, the data show that inhibition of viral polymerases by FNC-TP can translate to antiviral activity against both retroviruses and RNA viruses, but the link is not evident for SARS-CoV-2. FNC-TP is a poor substrate for SARS-CoV-2 RdRp, and FNC lacks significant antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2 in cell culture.
abstract_zh: 抗病毒核苷类似物的治疗价值在 2019 年冠状病毒病 (COVID-19) 大流行期间得到强调,瑞德西韦和莫努匹拉韦因其广谱抗病毒活性而被重新利用。胞苷类似物阿兹夫定 (FNC) 最近作为治疗人类免疫缺陷病毒 1 型 (HIV-1) 和严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒 2 (SARS-CoV-2) 感染的潜在疗法而受到关注。考虑到 HIV-1 逆转录酶 (RT) 和 SARS-CoV-2 RNA 依赖性 RNA 聚合酶 (RdRp) 不同的底物特异性,统一的抑制机制仍然难以捉摸。在这里,我们评估了 FNC 的活性三磷酸盐形式 FNC-TP 对几种病毒聚合酶的抑制作用。FNC-TP掺入的相对效率遵循以下顺序:HIV-1 RT>丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)RdRp>呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)RdRp>登革热病毒2型(DENV-2)RdRp≫SARS-CoV-2 RdRp。它的掺入导致所有测试的聚合酶链终止。针对 HIV-1 的抗病毒活性先前已得到证实,此处显示了 DENV-2 的抗病毒活性。总的来说,数据表明,FNC-TP 对病毒聚合酶的抑制可以转化为针对逆转录病毒和 RNA 病毒的抗病毒活性,但对于 SARS-CoV-2,这种联系并不明显。FNC-TP 是 SARS-CoV-2 RdRp 的较差底物,并且 FNC 在细胞培养物中缺乏针对 SARS-CoV-2 的显着抗病毒活性。

title: IMPLEMENTASI KEBIJAKAN PENANGGULANGAN DEMAM BERDARAH DENGUE (DBD) DI DESA KARANGNANAS KECAMATAN SOKARAJA
abstract: Implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD) merupakan upaya penting dalam menekan tingginya angka kasus DBD di Indonesia. Desa Karangnanas, Kecamatan Sokaraja, Kabupaten Banyumas tercatat sebagai desa dengan jumlah kasus DBD tertinggi di Kecamatan Sokaraja pada tahun 2024. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan DBD di Desa Karangnanas. Penelitian menggunakan metode kualitatif dengan pendekatan deskriptif. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi. Informan penelitian terdiri atas pemerintah desa, petugas puskesmas, kader kesehatan, dan masyarakat yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa implementasi kebijakan penanggulangan DBD di Desa Karangnanas secara umum telah berjalan cukup baik ditinjau dari aspek komunikasi, sumber daya, disposisi, dan struktur birokrasi menurut teori George C. Komunikasi dilakukan melalui penyuluhan kesehatan, kegiatan Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN), serta koordinasi antar pelaksana. Sumber daya didukung oleh tenaga kesehatan, kader, fasilitas, dan anggaran, meskipun masih terdapat keterbatasan sarana dan partisipasi masyarakat. Disposisi pelaksana dilaksanakan melalui komitmen dan tanggung jawab dalam pelaksanaan program, sedangkan struktur birokrasi didukung oleh prosedur operasional standar dan pembagian tugas yang jelas. Faktor pendukung implementasi meliputi koordinasi lintas sektor, dukungan pemerintah desa, keterlibatan kader kesehatan, dan media edukasi masyarakat. Faktor penghambat tersebut meliputi rendahnya partisipasi sebagian masyarakat, luasnya wilayah pengawasan, keterbatasan tenaga pelaksana, serta tingginya beban kerja kader kesehatan. Kata kunci: Implementasi Kebijakan, Demam Berdarah Dengue (DBD), Pemberantasan Sarang Nyamuk (PSN), Partisipasi Masyarakat

title: Climate Variability and Dengue Dynamics: A Path Analysis in Surabaya, Indonesia
abstract: Introduction: Dengue fever is a climate-sensitive vector-borne disease. While many studies have documented associations between climate variables and dengue incidence, most rely on conventional regression approaches that fail to separate direct and indirect climatic pathways, limiting mechanistic understanding and utility for environmental health. This study aims to elucidate the interconnected effects of climatic variability on dengue incidence in Surabaya. This study integrates seasonal time-series decomposition and path analysis to distinguish direct and indirect climatic pathways, sunlight duration and wind speed. Methods: A retrospective ecological design, monthly dengue incidence data from 2020 to 2024 were integrated with meteorological variables, including rainfall, temperature, humidity, sunlight duration, and wind speed. Seasonal time-series decomposition was applied to characterize temporal dynamics, followed by path analysis within a structural equation modeling framework to quantify direct and indirect climatic effects. Results and Discussion: A pronounced seasonal pattern in dengue incidence, with peaks during the rainy season. Maximum temperature, relative humidity, sunlight duration, and minimum wind speed exerted significant direct effects on dengue incidence (p < 0.05). Rainfall showed no direct association but acted as a key upstream driver influencing other climatic variables. The structural model explained 52.1% of the variance in dengue incidence, highlighting the contribution of interconnected climatic processes. Conclusion: These findings demonstrate that dengue dynamics in tropical metropolitan environments are governed by complex climate-mediated pathways rather than isolated climatic predictors. This study novel environmental epidemiological evidence to support climate-informed dengue early warning systems and adaptive vector control strategies under climate variability and urban environmental change.

abstract_zh: 简介:登革热是一种对气候敏感的媒介传播疾病。虽然许多研究已经记录了气候变量与登革热发病率之间的关联,但大多数研究都依赖于传统的回归方法,这些方法无法区分直接和间接的气候路径,限制了对环境健康的机制理解和效用。本研究旨在阐明气候变化对泗水登革热发病率的相互影响。这项研究整合了季节时间序列分解和路径分析,以区分直接和间接的气候路径、日照时长和风速。方法:采用回顾性生态设计,将2020年至2024年每月登革热发病数据与降雨量、温度、湿度、日照时长和风速等气象变量相结合。应用季节时间序列分解来表征时间动态,然后在结构方程模型框架内进行路径分析,以量化直接和间接的气候影响。结果和讨论:登革热发病具有明显的季节性模式,在雨季达到高峰。最高温度、相对湿度、日照时间和最小风速对登革热发病率产生显着的直接影响(p < 0.05)。降雨量没有显示出直接关联,但却是影响其他气候变量的关键上游驱动因素。该结构模型解释了登革热发病率差异的 52.1%,强调了相互关联的气候过程的贡献。结论:这些发现表明,热带大都市环境中的登革热动态受复杂的气候介导途径而非孤立的气候预测因子的控制。这项研究提供了新的环境流行病学证据,以支持气候变化和城市环境变化下的气候信息登革热早期预警系统和适应性病媒控制策略。

title: Integrated surveillance of arboviruses in febrile patients from the Brazilian Amazon reveals complex co-circulation dynamics and hidden viral diversity
abstract: ABSTRACT Background: Arboviral infections continue to be a significant public health challenge in the Brazilian Amazon. Overlapping symptoms, limited laboratory access, and the circulation of multiple arboviruses hamper clinical diagnosis. This study aimed to characterize the epidemiological, clinical, laboratory and genomic profiles of arboviral infections in febrile patients in Manaus, Brazil, and explore additional viral agents using metagenomic sequencing. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted between February 2021 and February 2023 at a tertiary reference center in Manaus, Brazil. Patients aged ≥ 5 years of age presenting with a rash and either a fever or a history of fever lasting <7 days and a negative thick blood smear for malaria were enrolled. Serum samples were tested for dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), yellow fever virus (YF), Oropouche virus (OROV), and Mayaro virus (MAYV) using ELISA and RT-qPCR. Positive samples were subjected to amplicon-based genome sequencing for phylogenetic analysis. A subset of RT-qPCR negative samples was analyzed using de novo shotgun metagenomic sequencing. Results: Among the 708 enrolled participants, 243 (34.3%) had a laboratory-confirmed arboviral infection: 92 (37.9%) DENV, 64 (26.3%) CHIKV, and 4 (1.6%) ZIKV, while 83 (34.2%) laboratory profiles were compatible with coinfection, predominantly DENV+CHIKV (55/83; 66.3%). Circulation of DENV-1 genotype V and DENV-2 genotypes III (Asian American) and II (Cosmopolitan) was identified. Metagenomic analysis of 35 samples detected Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1. Conclusions: These findings demonstrate complex arbovirus co-circulation in Manaus and support integrated surveillance strategies combining molecular, serological, and genomic approaches.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study in Manaus, Brazil, enrolled 708 febrile patients with rash to characterize arboviral infections between 2021 and 2023. Using ELISA, RT-qPCR, and metagenomic sequencing, 34.3% of participants tested positive for arboviruses, with dengue (37.9%), chikungunya (26.3%), and Zika (1.6%) predominating. Metagenomics revealed Pegivirus hominis and Erythroparvovirus primate 1 in 35 samples. The authors conclude that integrated surveillance combining molecular, serological, and genomic methods is essential to address complex arbovirus co-circulation and hidden viral diversity in endemic settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于重叠的临床表现、有限的诊断能力以及多种病毒的共同传播,虫媒病毒感染对巴西亚马逊地区造成了持续的公共卫生负担。该研究解决了巴西马瑙斯发热患者虫媒病毒感染特征的需要,该地区的诊断挑战阻碍了准确识别。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2021 年 2 月至 2023 年 2 月在巴西马瑙斯的一个三级参考中心进行了一项横断面研究。年龄为 5 岁或以上、有皮疹、发烧或发烧史持续不到 7 天、疟疾厚血涂片呈阴性的患者被纳入研究。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 ELISA 和 RT-qPCR 检测血清样本中的登革热病毒 (DENV)、寨卡病毒 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV)、黄热病病毒 (YF)、奥罗普切病毒 (OROV) 和马亚罗病毒 (MAYV)。阳性样本进行了基于扩增子的基因组测序以进行系统发育分析,而 RT-qPCR 阴性样本的子集则使用从头鸟枪法宏基因组测序进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 708 名参与者中,243 名(34.3%)人患有实验室确诊的虫媒病毒感染:92 名(37.9%)DENV、64 名(26.3%)CHIKV 和 4 名(1.6%)ZIKV。在 83 例 (34.2%) 病例中检测到混合感染,主要是 DENV+CHIKV (55/83;66.3%)。鉴定出 DENV-1 基因型 V 和 DENV-2 基因型 III(亚裔美国人)和 II(国际大都会)。对 35 个样本的宏基因组分析检测到人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究证明了马瑙斯虫媒病毒的复杂共循环,并强调了结合分子、血清学和基因组方法的综合监测的实用性。对人型佩吉病毒和灵长类红细小病毒 1 型的新检测扩大了发热患者中已知的病毒多样性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调需要采取综合诊断策略来改善虫媒病毒流行地区的监测和患者管理。其他病毒因子的检测表明发热性疾病中非虫媒病毒病原体的诊断可能存在不足。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计和单中心设置的限制,这可能会限制普遍性。依赖 RT-qPCR 和 ELISA 进行初步检测会带来潜在的假阴性,而且宏基因组测序仅应用于一小部分样本,限制了更广泛的结论。

title: Enfermedades transmitidas por vectores: chagas, dengue, malaria y hantavirus
abstract: Rol estratégico de la Atención Primaria: el personal médico de familia es fundamental para el cribado inicial, el manejo ambulatorio de los casos leves y la prevención del colapso hospitalario. title: Rural dengue dynamics: the interplay of climate, built environment, and agriculture in Costa Rica
abstract: Dengue is one of the worlds highest-burden arboviral diseases. Although classically considered an urban disease, many regions experience a substantial dengue burden in rural areas. The combined influence of long-term climate, short-term weather variation, local built environments, and land-use gradients on dengue dynamics in rural settings remains poorly understood, limiting our ability to predict shifting risk under global change. Here, we investigate these dynamics in Costa Rica to disentangle how these interacting socio-environmental factors shape rural dengue transmission. We first use 22 years of canton-level (admin-2) case data to establish that both dengue cases and incidence are consistently higher in rural than in urban districts. Then, using ten years of district-level (admin-3) monthly case data and a Bayesian hierarchical modeling framework, we identify the climatic and land-use features most strongly associated with dengue risk. Temperature underlies broad spatial patterns in dengues urban-rural distribution, while precipitation effects differ between coasts, reflecting intercoastal climate zone contrasts rather than interactions between urbanization and water availability. Given suitable climate, even modest levels of built infrastructure substantially increase risk, but the relationship plateaus at higher levels of building volume. Dengue risk is also elevated in areas with high agricultural crop cover at low and mid elevations but not at higher, cooler elevations. Together these results suggest that high risk of rural dengue in Costa Rica result from climate suitability aligning with baseline levels of built infrastructure, with agriculture potentially emerging as a distinct driver of rural dengue transmission.

abstract_zh: 登革热是世界上负担最重的虫媒病毒疾病之一。尽管通常被认为是一种城市疾病,但许多地区的农村地区都面临着巨大的登革热负担。长期气候、短期天气变化、当地建筑环境和土地利用梯度对农村地区登革热动态的综合影响仍知之甚少,限制了我们预测全球变化下风险转移的能力。在这里,我们调查了哥斯达黎加的这些动态,以阐明这些相互作用的社会环境因素如何影响农村登革热传播。我们首先使用 22 年的州级 (admin-2) 病例数据来确定农村地区的登革热病例和发病率始终高于城市地区。然后,利用十年来的区级 (admin-3) 每月病例数据和贝叶斯分层建模框架,我们确定了与登革热风险最密切相关的气候和土地利用特征。温度是登革热城乡分布的广泛空间模式的基础,而沿海之间的降水影响不同,反映了沿海气候区的对比,而不是城市化和水资源可用性之间的相互作用。在适宜的气候条件下,即使是适度的基础设施建设也会显着增加风险,但这种关系在建筑量较高的情况下会趋于稳定。在低海拔和中海拔农作物覆盖率较高的地区,登革热风险也较高,但在较高、较冷的海拔地区则不然。这些结果共同表明,哥斯达黎加农村登革热的高风险是由于气候适宜性与已建基础设施的基线水平一致造成的,而农业可能成为农村登革热传播的独特驱动因素。

title: Detection of Dengue Virus in Aedes aegypti Mosquitoes, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
abstract: We performed a 1-year mosquito survey in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, after a dengue virus outbreak in 2024. We collected 1,598 Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and detected dengue virus in 5 pools of < 20 mosquitoes. Our findings underscore the importance of sustained vector surveillance for dengue virus in arid urban environments.

full_text: Les moustiques invasifs ne constituent pas seulement une menace sanitaire : ils représentent aussi un coût économique majeur. Une étude internationale estime qu’entre 1975 et 2020, les maladies transmises par les moustiques Aedes ont engendré au moins 94,7 milliards de dollars de pertes dans le monde. Plus frappant encore, les dépenses consacrées à la prévention restent très inférieures aux coûts supportés une fois les épidémies déclarées. Ils sont petits, à peine visibles, et pourtant leur impact économique atteint une ampleur comparable à celle de certaines crises sanitaires majeures. Les moustiques invasifs du genre Aedes – notamment Aedes albopictus (moustique tigre) et Aedes aegypti (son cousin, moins connu en Europe, le moustique de la fièvre jaune)- ne se contentent pas de troubler nos soirées estivales, ils nous transmettent les virus de la dengue, de la fièvre jaune, chikungunya ou encore Zika et, ce faisant, ils engendrent également des coûts considérables pour les systèmes de santé, les collectivités et les ménages du monde entier. Dans une étude publiée en 2024 dans Science of The Total Environment on estime qu’entre 1975 et 2020, les coûts économiques liés à ces moustiques et aux maladies qu’ils transmettent, atteignent au minimum 94,7 milliards (en dollars de 2022). Les estimations hautes suggèrent elles un coût total supérieur à 300 milliards lorsque les séquelles à long terme sont prises en compte, soit un montant comparable au coût total de l’ouragan Katrina, l’une des catastrophes naturelles les plus coûteuses de l’histoire contemporaine, et supérieur à ceux de la catastrophe pétrolière de Deepwater Horizon en 2010 dans le golfe du Mexique. Derrière ce chiffre impressionnant, on trouve une réalité plus préoccupante encore : cette évaluation est sans doute largement sous-estimée et, contrairement à une catastrophe ponctuelle, ces coûts s’accumulent année après année. Et surtout, elle révèle un déséquilibre majeur dans nos choix collectifs : nous dépensons beaucoup plus pour réparer les dégâts que pour prévenir les crises, environ dix fois plus. Une expansion silencieuse, un coût croissant Pour comprendre ces montants colossaux, il faut d’abord regarder l’expansion silencieuse des moustiques concernés. Issus de régions tropicales, les moustiques Aedes ont étendu leur aire de répartition à un rythme soutenu. Aedes aegypti, originaire d’Afrique, est aujourd’hui présent dans une grande partie des régions tropicales et subtropicales d’Amérique, d’Asie et d’Océanie. Son aire de répartition s’est progressivement étendue sous l’effet des échanges commerciaux et de l’urbanisation. Aedes albopictus, le moustique tigre, lui, a colonisé le monde plus tardivement, à partir des années 1970, en provenance d’Asie. Portés par la mondialisation des échanges (commerce international, transport maritime et aérien), l’urbanisation rapide et souvent mal planifiée, ainsi que par le réchauffement climatique, ces vecteurs de virus se sont implantés sur tous les continents, y compris en Europe et en Amérique du Nord. Leur succès écologique a une conséquence directe : l’augmentation du nombre d’épidémies. La dengue, autrefois confinée à certaines régions tropicales, est devenue l’une des maladies virales à transmission vectorielle les plus répandues au monde. Présente dans plus de 100 pays, elle connaît des flambées de plus en plus fréquentes et de plus en plus importantes, avec des niveaux records observés ces dernières années. En 2023 et 2024, plusieurs pays d’Amérique latine, dont le Brésil et l’Argentine, ont enregistré des épidémies historiques comptant plusieurs millions de cas. Le chikungunya et le Zika ont provoqué des crises sanitaires majeures depuis le début des années 2000, avec des répercussions sanitaires durables, notamment des complications neurologiques et congénitales. Cette crise sanitaire est aussi une crise économique, dont les conséquences restent largement sous-estimées dans le débat public. 94,7 milliards de dollars : une estimation minimale Notre équipe a compilé les données issues de la base internationale InvaCost) qui recense les coûts économiques associés aux espèces invasives. Sur une période de 45 ans (1975-2020), nous avons identifié au moins 94,7 milliards de dollars (soit environ 105 milliards en dollars 2026) de coûts cumulés liés aux moustiques Aedes et aux maladies qu’ils transmettent. Cela représente en moyenne plus de 3 milliards de dollars par an, avec des pics spectaculaires : en 2013, la facture a dépassé les 20 milliards de dollars. Ces montants incluent plusieurs types de dépenses : les coûts médicaux (hospitalisations, consultations, traitements), les pertes de productivité liées aux arrêts de travail, les dépenses publiques de surveillance et de lutte antivectorielle (limitation des populations de moustiques par divers moyens dont les campagnes de participation communautaire pour la réduction d’eaux stagnantes, les larvicides, où les insecticides), ainsi que certains impacts économiques indirects (comme l’absentéisme ou des baisses de productivité). La dengue représente à elle seule près de 80 % des coûts totaux estimés. Le chikungunya et le Zika, bien que plus ponctuels dans leur émergence, contribuent également de manière significative dans la dernière décennie, reflétant plusieurs grandes crises épidémiques sur la période. Mais ces chiffres impressionnants ne représentent pourtant qu’une partie de la réalité. Une sous-estimation structurelle De fait, les 94,7 milliards de dollars identifiés ne représentent que les coûts documentés et publiés dans la littérature scientifique ou institutionnelle. Il ne s’agit pas d’estimations ni d’extrapolations. Or, de nombreux pays, notamment à revenu faible ou intermédiaire, ne disposent pas des moyens pour mesurer et documenter ces impacts économiques. Les dépenses informelles des ménages, les pertes économiques non déclarées, les conséquences à long terme sur la santé (handicaps, troubles neurologiques, complications congénitales liées au Zika), ou encore les effets sur le tourisme et l’attractivité économique (le nombre de visiteurs chute drastiquement dans les pays connaissant une épidémie) sont rarement quantifiés. Autrement dit, la facture réelle pourrait être bien plus élevée. Ce biais révèle en outre une inégalité structurelle : les pays les plus touchés sont souvent ceux qui disposent des systèmes de surveillance les moins robustes, en particulier dans plusieurs régions d’Asie du Sud-Est, d’Afrique subsaharienne et d’Amérique latine. Le manque de données n’est pas synonyme d’absence de coût : il traduit plutôt une invisibilisation économique des régions les plus vulnérables. Réagir et soigner plutôt que prévenir : un choix coûteux Anticiper ces conséquences et investir dans la prévention, la surveillance et la gestion intégrée des vecteurs apparaît donc essentiel pour limiter les effets sanitaires, économiques et sociaux des futures épidémies. Les données montrent cependant que les coûts liés aux « dommages et pertes » – c’est-à-dire les conséquences des maladies une fois qu’elles surviennent – sont largement supérieurs aux dépenses consacrées à la prévention et à la gestion. En d’autres termes, on dépense beaucoup plus en réaction aux épidémies que pour les empêcher. Les campagnes de démoustication, la surveillance entomologique, l’amélioration des infrastructures urbaines (gestion des eaux stagnantes, assainissement), ou encore la recherche sur les méthodes innovantes de contrôle des populations de moustiques (comme la dissémination de moustiques porteurs de Wolbachia ou de mâles stériles) restent sous-financées par rapport à l’ampleur des dommages constatés. Ce déséquilibre pose une question centrale de politique publique : pourquoi attendons-nous que la crise éclate pour agir ? Read more: Les lâchers de moustiques modifiés pour lutter contre la dengue, le chikungunya ou la fièvre jaune La réponse est en partie politique et budgétaire. Les dépenses de prévention sont souvent moins visibles, moins médiatisées, et leurs bénéfices sont difficiles à attribuer directement. À l’inverse, les coûts des épidémies apparaissent brutalement dans les statistiques hospitalières et économiques. Mais cette logique court-termiste se révèle économiquement inefficace. Les données montrent pourtant qu’un investissement accru dans la prévention pourrait réduire significativement la charge économique globale à long terme. Une problématique sociale mondiale Au-delà des chiffres, l’enjeu est profondément social. Les maladies transmises par les moustiques Aedes touchent de manière disproportionnée les populations urbaines défavorisées, vivant dans des environnements où l’accès à l’eau potable, à l’assainissement et aux infrastructures sanitaires est limité. Les inégalités socio-économiques favorisent la prolifération des moustiques : stockage d’eau dans des récipients ouverts, absence de systèmes d’évacuation performants, habitat dense et précaire. Les populations les plus vulnérables cumulent donc les risques sanitaires et les pertes économiques. Lorsqu’un membre d’un foyer tombe malade, les conséquences dépassent le simple coût médical : perte de revenus, déscolarisation temporaire des enfants, endettement pour financer les soins. À l’échelle collective, ces micro-chocs économiques s’additionnent pour former un fardeau macroéconomique. La mondialisation du phénomène ajoute une dimension supplémentaire : même les pays tempérés, longtemps considérés comme à l’abri, voient désormais l’implantation durable de Aedes albopictus. Les épisodes autochtones de dengue ou de chikungunya en Europe illustrent cette nouvelle réalité et les récentes projections climatiques suggèrent que le potentiel de transmission pourrait encore s’étendre dans les décennies à venir. La question n’est plus celle d’un « problème tropical », mais d’un enjeu global. Read more: Virus « exotiques » dans l’Hexagone : Que faut-il savoir du chikungunya ? Une alerte et une opportunité Cette lecture économique permet de renouveler notre compréhension d’un problème souvent abordé sous le seul angle sanitaire. En mettant un coût sur les conséquences des invasions de moustiques Aedes, cette étude déplace le débat vers le terrain des politiques publiques et des arbitrages budgétaires. Les moustiques ne sont pas seulement une nuisance estivale. Ils représentent un coût structurel croissant pour les systèmes de santé, les économies nationales et les ménages. Dans un monde marqué par l’intensification des échanges et les bouleversements climatiques, ils illustrent une réalité concrète : certains impacts économiques des transformations environnementales ne sont ni abstraits ni lointains. Ils se traduisent en milliards de dollars, en inégalités sociales accrues et en systèmes de santé sous tension. Reconnaître l’ampleur économique du phénomène conduit ainsi à changer de perspective : dans un contexte de mondialisation des échanges et de changement climatique, la lutte antivectorielle n’est plus seulement une mesure de santé publique. Elle constitue un investissement collectif destiné à éviter des coûts sanitaires, sociaux et économiques bien plus élevés demain.

full_text_sections.full_text: Les moustiques invasifs ne constituent pas seulement une menace sanitaire : ils représentent aussi un coût économique majeur. Une étude internationale estime qu’entre 1975 et 2020, les maladies transmises par les moustiques Aedes ont engendré au moins 94,7 milliards de dollars de pertes dans le monde. Plus frappant encore, les dépenses consacrées à la prévention restent très inférieures aux coûts supportés une fois les épidémies déclarées. Ils sont petits, à peine visibles, et pourtant leur impact économique atteint une ampleur comparable à celle de certaines crises sanitaires majeures. Les moustiques invasifs du genre Aedes – notamment Aedes albopictus (moustique tigre) et Aedes aegypti (son cousin, moins connu en Europe, le moustique de la fièvre jaune)- ne se contentent pas de troubler nos soirées estivales, ils nous transmettent les virus de la dengue, de la fièvre jaune, chikungunya ou encore Zika et, ce faisant, ils engendrent également des coûts considérables pour les systèmes de santé, les collectivités et les ménages du monde entier. Dans une étude publiée en 2024 dans Science of The Total Environment on estime qu’entre 1975 et 2020, les coûts économiques liés à ces moustiques et aux maladies qu’ils transmettent, atteignent au minimum 94,7 milliards (en dollars de 2022). Les estimations hautes suggèrent elles un coût total supérieur à 300 milliards lorsque les séquelles à long terme sont prises en compte, soit un montant comparable au coût total de l’ouragan Katrina, l’une des catastrophes naturelles les plus coûteuses de l’histoire contemporaine, et supérieur à ceux de la catastrophe pétrolière de Deepwater Horizon en 2010 dans le golfe du Mexique. Derrière ce chiffre impressionnant, on trouve une réalité plus préoccupante encore : cette évaluation est sans doute largement sous-estimée et, contrairement à une catastrophe ponctuelle, ces coûts s’accumulent année après année. Et surtout, elle révèle un déséquilibre majeur dans nos choix collectifs : nous dépensons beaucoup plus pour réparer les dégâts que pour prévenir les crises, environ dix fois plus. Une expansion silencieuse, un coût croissant Pour comprendre ces montants colossaux, il faut d’abord regarder l’expansion silencieuse des moustiques concernés. Issus de régions tropicales, les moustiques Aedes ont étendu leur aire de répartition à un rythme soutenu. Aedes aegypti, originaire d’Afrique, est aujourd’hui présent dans une grande partie des régions tropicales et subtropicales d’Amérique, d’Asie et d’Océanie. Son aire de répartition s’est progressivement étendue sous l’effet des échanges commerciaux et de l’urbanisation. Aedes albopictus, le moustique tigre, lui, a colonisé le monde plus tardivement, à partir des années 1970, en provenance d’Asie. Portés par la mondialisation des échanges (commerce international, transport maritime et aérien), l’urbanisation rapide et souvent mal planifiée, ainsi que par le réchauffement climatique, ces vecteurs de virus se sont implantés sur tous les continents, y compris en Europe et en Amérique du Nord. Leur succès écologique a une conséquence directe : l’augmentation du nombre d’épidémies. La dengue, autrefois confinée à certaines régions tropicales, est devenue l’une des maladies virales à transmission vectorielle les plus répandues au monde. Présente dans plus de 100 pays, elle connaît des flambées de plus en plus fréquentes et de plus en plus importantes, avec des niveaux records observés ces dernières années. En 2023 et 2024, plusieurs pays d’Amérique latine, dont le Brésil et l’Argentine, ont enregistré des épidémies historiques comptant plusieurs millions de cas. Le chikungunya et le Zika ont provoqué des crises sanitaires majeures depuis le début des années 2000, avec des répercussions sanitaires durables, notamment des complications neurologiques et congénitales. Cette crise sanitaire est aussi une crise économique, dont les conséquences restent largement sous-estimées dans le débat public. 94,7 milliards de dollars : une estimation minimale Notre équipe a compilé les données issues de la base internationale InvaCost) qui recense les coûts économiques associés aux espèces invasives. Sur une période de 45 ans (1975-2020), nous avons identifié au moins 94,7 milliards de dollars (soit environ 105 milliards en dollars 2026) de coûts cumulés liés aux moustiques Aedes et aux maladies qu’ils transmettent. Cela représente en moyenne plus de 3 milliards de dollars par an, avec des pics spectaculaires : en 2013, la facture a dépassé les 20 milliards de dollars. Ces montants incluent plusieurs types de dépenses : les coûts médicaux (hospitalisations, consultations, traitements), les pertes de productivité liées aux arrêts de travail, les dépenses publiques de surveillance et de lutte antivectorielle (limitation des populations de moustiques par divers moyens dont les campagnes de participation communautaire pour la réduction d’eaux stagnantes, les larvicides, où les insecticides), ainsi que certains impacts économiques indirects (comme l’absentéisme ou des baisses de productivité). La dengue représente à elle seule près de 80 % des coûts totaux estimés. Le chikungunya et le Zika, bien que plus ponctuels dans leur émergence, contribuent également de manière significative dans la dernière décennie, reflétant plusieurs grandes crises épidémiques sur la période. Mais ces chiffres impressionnants ne représentent pourtant qu’une partie de la réalité. Une sous-estimation structurelle De fait, les 94,7 milliards de dollars identifiés ne représentent que les coûts documentés et publiés dans la littérature scientifique ou institutionnelle. Il ne s’agit pas d’estimations ni d’extrapolations. Or, de nombreux pays, notamment à revenu faible ou intermédiaire, ne disposent pas des moyens pour mesurer et documenter ces impacts économiques. Les dépenses informelles des ménages, les pertes économiques non déclarées, les conséquences à long terme sur la santé (handicaps, troubles neurologiques, complications congénitales liées au Zika), ou encore les effets sur le tourisme et l’attractivité économique (le nombre de visiteurs chute drastiquement dans les pays connaissant une épidémie) sont rarement quantifiés. Autrement dit, la facture réelle pourrait être bien plus élevée. Ce biais révèle en outre une inégalité structurelle : les pays les plus touchés sont souvent ceux qui disposent des systèmes de surveillance les moins robustes, en particulier dans plusieurs régions d’Asie du Sud-Est, d’Afrique subsaharienne et d’Amérique latine. Le manque de données n’est pas synonyme d’absence de coût : il traduit plutôt une invisibilisation économique des régions les plus vulnérables. Réagir et soigner plutôt que prévenir : un choix coûteux Anticiper ces conséquences et investir dans la prévention, la surveillance et la gestion intégrée des vecteurs apparaît donc essentiel pour limiter les effets sanitaires, économiques et sociaux des futures épidémies. Les données montrent cependant que les coûts liés aux « dommages et pertes » – c’est-à-dire les conséquences des maladies une fois qu’elles surviennent – sont largement supérieurs aux dépenses consacrées à la prévention et à la gestion. En d’autres termes, on dépense beaucoup plus en réaction aux épidémies que pour les empêcher. Les campagnes de démoustication, la surveillance entomologique, l’amélioration des infrastructures urbaines (gestion des eaux stagnantes, assainissement), ou encore la recherche sur les méthodes innovantes de contrôle des populations de moustiques (comme la dissémination de moustiques porteurs de Wolbachia ou de mâles stériles) restent sous-financées par rapport à l’ampleur des dommages constatés. Ce déséquilibre pose une question centrale de politique publique : pourquoi attendons-nous que la crise éclate pour agir ? title: Climate change and the growing threat of bunyaviruses
abstract: ABSTRACT Anthropogenic climate change and its implications for infectious diseases have been central to the scientific and public health discourse for more than three decades. In 2026, we have now entered a climate adaptation phase, with accumulating evidence demonstrating that ongoing climatic variability is directly reshaping the dynamics of multiple vector-borne viruses, including bunyaviruses. Bunyaviruses comprise a diverse group of segmented, negative-sense RNA viruses that include significant human and veterinary pathogens, such as Rift Valley fever virus, Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus, Oropouche virus, and Cache Valley fever virus. Despite their medical and veterinary importance, climate-virus relationships remain comparatively less well characterized for bunyaviruses than for viruses such as dengue, Zika, chikungunya, and yellow fever. This gap is increasingly notable in light of recent epidemiological shifts, exemplified by the 2022–2025 expansion of Oropouche virus across the Americas and the Caribbean, which highlights how bunyaviruses can exploit ecological disruption and underscores the need to better understand the environmental determinants of their transmission. Advances in genomic surveillance, experimental virology, and climate-informed epidemiology now enable these interconnected virus-host-vector-environment dynamics to be examined with increasing precision. In this minireview, we synthesize current evidence linking environmental change to bunyavirus transmission and geographic expansion, identify critical mechanistic and surveillance gaps, and outline priorities for developing predictive frameworks to strengthen bunyavirus preparedness within a One Health context.

abstract_zh: 摘要 三十多年来,人为气候变化及其对传染病的影响一直是科学和公共卫生讨论的核心。2026 年,我们现已进入气候适应阶段,越来越多的证据表明,持续的气候变化正在直接重塑包括布尼亚病毒在内的多种媒介传播病毒的动态。布尼亚病毒由多种分段、负义 RNA 病毒组成,其中包括重要的人类和兽医病原体,例如裂谷热病毒、克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒、奥罗普切病毒和卡什谷热病毒。尽管布尼亚病毒在医学和兽医学上具有重要意义,但与登革热、寨卡病毒、基孔肯雅热和黄热病等病毒相比,气候与病毒之间的关系仍然不太清楚。鉴于最近的流行病学变化,这一差距日益显着,例如 2022 年至 2025 年奥罗普切病毒在美洲和加勒比地区的扩张,这凸显了布尼亚病毒如何利用生态破坏,并强调需要更好地了解其传播的环境决定因素。基因组监测、实验病毒学和气候流行病学的进步现在使这些相互关联的病毒-宿主-载体-环境动态能够得到越来越精确的检查。在这篇小型综述中,我们综合了将环境变化与布尼亚病毒传播和地理扩张联系起来的现有证据,确定了关键的机制和监测差距,并概述了开发预测框架的优先事项,以在“同一个健康”背景下加强布尼亚病毒的防范。

title: Exploration of viral diversity in Aedes mosquitoes employing different shotgun metagenomic data analysis pipelines.
abstract: Metagenomics or metaviromics is emerging as a powerful technology for pathogen surveillance and pandemic preparedness. Mosquitoes are important vectors for transmission of many emerging viruses responsible for numerous outbreaks. Monitoring mosquitoes becomes essential to investigate its virome which leads to understanding of disease dynamics and allow preventive actions. In this study, shotgun metagenomic methodology using Ion GeneStudio S5 System was optimized for exploration of viral diversity. A total of 1913 Aedes larvae were collected from Central India during post monsoon season of 2024. Aedes larvae reared to adulthood and processed for sequencing using Ion Torrent S5 platform. Computational analyses were performed using three bioinformatic pipelines: Chan Zuckerberg ID (CZ ID), Genome Detective Platform and the Galaxy Platform. A mock database of 11 known viruses was created as well as publicly available NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) datasets were used to validate all three pipelines. In terms of detection accuracy, Genome Detective and CZ ID performed exceptionally well and therefore may be suitable for future mosquito virome surveillance studies. We found presence of viruses viz. Alphamesonivirus cavallynense and Phasivirus phasiense dominating in all samples. Dengue virus was detected in one sample by CZ ID, whereas Wenzhou sobemo-like virus, Hubei mosquito virus 2, Cell fusing agent virus found most commonly among samples. Other viruses found like Aedes anphevirus (AeAV; genus Glybovirus), Aedes totivirus, Verdadero virus and Chaq-like virus. Variation in the result among different pipelines are likely attributable to incorporation of different viral reference databases, classification algorithms, metrics and analysis parameters. To the best of our knowledge, this study represents the first metagenomic study of mosquitoes using Ion GeneStudio S5 platform in India. The findings provide a comparative evaluation of the metagenomic pipelines and elucidates detailed information of each pipeline and its working for future studies.

Monitoring mosquitoes becomes essential to investigate its virome which leads to understanding of disease dynamics and allow preventive actions. In this study, shotgun metagenomic methodology using Ion GeneStudio S5 System was optimized for exploration of viral diversity. A total of 1913 Aedes larvae were collected from Central India during post monsoon season of 2024. Aedes larvae reared to adulthood and processed for sequencing using Ion Torrent S5 platform. Computational analyses were performed using three bioinformatic pipelines: Chan Zuckerberg ID (CZ ID), Genome Detective Platform and the Galaxy Platform. A mock database of 11 known viruses was created as well as publicly available NCBI Sequence Read Archive (SRA) datasets were used to validate all three pipelines. In terms of detection accuracy, Genome Detective and CZ ID performed exceptionally well and therefore may be suitable for future mosquito virome surveillance studies. We found presence of viruses viz. Alphamesonivirus cavallynense and Phasivirus phasiense dominating in all samples. Dengue virus was detected in one sample by CZ ID, whereas Wenzhou sobemo-like virus, Hubei mosquito virus 2, Cell fusing agent virus found most commonly among samples. Other viruses found like Aedes anphevirus (AeAV; genus Glybovirus), Aedes totivirus, Verdadero virus and Chaq-like virus. Variation in the result among different pipelines are likely attributable to incorporation of different viral reference databases, classification algorithms, metrics and analysis parameters. To the best of our knowledge, this study represents the first metagenomic study of mosquitoes using Ion GeneStudio S5 platform in India. The findings provide a comparative evaluation of the metagenomic pipelines and elucidates detailed information of each pipeline and its working for future studies.

abstract_zh: 宏基因组学或元病毒组学正在成为病原体监测和大流行防范的强大技术。蚊子是传播许多新出现的病毒的重要载体,这些病毒导致了许多疫情的爆发。监测蚊子对于研究其病毒组至关重要,这有助于了解疾病动态并采取预防措施。在本研究中,使用 Ion GeneStudio S5 系统的鸟枪法宏基因组方法经过优化,可探索病毒多样性。2024 年季风后季节,从印度中部收集了总共 1913 只伊蚊幼虫。将伊蚊幼虫饲养至成年,并使用 Ion Torrent S5 平台进行测序。使用三个生物信息学管道进行计算分析:Chan Zuckerberg ID (CZ ID)、Genome Detective Platform 和 Galaxy Platform。创建了 11 种已知病毒的模拟数据库,并使用公开可用的 NCBI 序列读取存档 (SRA) 数据集来验证所有三个管道。在检测准确性方面,Genome Detective 和 CZ ID 表现非常出色,因此可能适合未来的蚊子病毒组监测研究。我们发现病毒的存在。Alphamesonivirus cavallynense 和 Phasivirus phasiense 在所有样本中占主导地位。CZ ID在1个样本中检出登革热病毒,而样本中最常见的是温州索贝莫样病毒、湖北蚊子病毒2型、细胞融合剂病毒。发现的其他病毒如伊蚊病毒(AeAV;糖病毒属)、伊蚊托蒂病毒、Verdadero 病毒和 Chaq 样病毒。不同管道之间结果的差异可能归因于不同病毒参考数据库、分类算法、指标和分析参数的结合。据我们所知,这项研究是印度首次使用 Ion GeneStudio S5 平台对蚊子进行宏基因组研究。研究结果提供了宏基因组管道的比较评估,并阐明了每个管道的详细信息及其对未来研究的作用。
